item.title: Festival de los Andes — Sat Sep 26, 2:00 PM — AMPHITHEATER MONTCLAIR STATE UNIVERSITY
item.description: Celebrate the rich cultures and traditions of the Andean region at the second annual Festival de los Andes at Montclair State University! Join us on Saturday, September 26, from 2:00–7:00 p.m. at the Amphitheater on our campus for an afternoon of live Andean music, traditional dance, singing, artists and artisans, interactive cultural workshops, food, and family-friendly activities. Organized by CLaSE (Center for Latino heritage and Spanish language Excellence) and community partners, the festival brings together the University and surrounding communities to celebrate, learn from, and experience the cultural diversity and living traditions of the Andes. item.title: What's Up with KidLit? Industry Experts Panel — Sun Sep 27, 1:30 PM — Online – Virtual
item.description: What’s Up with KidLit? Industry experts on crafting stories for young readers From enchanting picture books to riveting young adult novels, books have the power to turn young people into lifelong readers. But children’s literature has also become a battleground in the culture wars, readership is in deep decline, and AI is everywhere. What is the state of children’s literature today? And what will make your story stand out from the crowd? This panel features three industry professionals with comprehensive knowledge of the field. Our discussion will provide candid insights into the current children’s literary landscape, evolving children’s publishing trends, and provide practical tips for aspiring writers and insights for parents and educators into the unique challenges and opportunities of children’s publishing today. If you want a clear understanding of how books make a difference, and how yours can stand out in a competitive field, join us. PANELISTS: Maria Russo is an Editor-at-L

item.title: Black Veil Brides: Vindicatour US 2026 — Sun Sep 27, 5:30 PM — The Wellmont Theater
item.description:
Committed to uncompromising expression, with a foundation in hard rock tradition and rule-breaking iconoclasm, Black Veil Brides is a transcendent celebration of life-affirming power and anthemic catharsis. A gothic vision first summoned in a small town by an isolated kid fascinated with death, rock, theatricality, and monsters (both real and imagined), Black Veil Brides is now a postmodern heavy metal institution with a legion of like-minded fans and supporters worldwide. Black Veil Brides champion the isolated, dismissed and forgotten ever since the band’s inception. That spirit persists in the fully realized modern incarnation of the band. They’re an object of devotion and obsession for those who sing their anthems in unison, a diverse legion who refuse to surrender. Share this: Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

item.title: Theater League of Clifton Announces Auditions for “1776” — Sun Sep 27, 7:00 PM
item.description: The Theater League of Clifton will hold auditions for its upcoming production of “1776” on Tuesday, September 15; Wednesday, September 16; and Thursday, September 17, from 7:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Callbacks by invitation may also be held Thursday, September 17. Auditions will be held at Living Hope, 303 Maplewood Ave., Clifton, NJ 07013. Performances will be held November 13, 14 and 15 at the Wayne Community Center, 1 Pike Drive, Wayne, NJ. The production will be directed by Maren Sugarman. With music and lyrics by Sherman Edwards and a book by Peter Stone, 1776 dramatizes the struggle within the Second Continental Congress to declare American independence. John Adams, Benjamin Franklin and Thomas Jefferson attempt to persuade a divided Congress to break with England while political, regional and personal conflicts threaten to derail the effort. item.title: Atlantic City (Harrah's) Day Trip with South End Gardens Tenants Association — Mon Sep 28 — South End Gardens Tenants Association/Harrah’s Hotel & Casino (AC)
item.description: The South End Gardens Tenants Association is hosting a day trip to Harrah’s Resort Atlantic City on Monday, September 28, 2026. Round-trip motorcoach transportation will depart directly from South End Gardens in Montclair, New Jersey, providing a direct and comfortable ride to the Marina District. Tickets are priced at $50 per person, which covers charter bus transit along with a $20 casino slot play voucher provided by Harrah’s upon arrival. During the visit, attendees will have full access to the expansive gaming floor, including thousands of slot machines, table games, and the Caesars Sportsbook. Guests can also enjoy a wide range of dining options—from casual meals at Gordon Ramsay Steak and Coastal Craft Kitchen to quick-service dining in the food court—or relax near the resort’s signature glass-domed pool area before the evening return trip to Montclair.
